courses.title: Major Core
courses.choice_note: [5] Major Core - LATS 3301 and (HIST 3398 or HIST 3339)

courses.title: Major Elective
courses.choice_note: [6] Major Elective - 18 semester credit hours - Students must complete courses from the following list in at least two disciplinary areas. Students must complete at least 9 semester credit hours in a single disciplinary area. History Electives: HIST 3391, HIST 3398, HIST 3399, HIST 4369, HIST 4359, HIST 3397, or other HIST courses with emphasis on Latin America may be considered. Social Science Electives: CRIM 3319, GEOG 2302, GEOG 2309, GEOG 3359, GEOS 2321, PSCI 4348 or other geographical, political, and economic courses with emphasis on Latin America may be considered. Language, Literature, and Culture Electives: LATS 3301, LATS 3302, LATS 3303, LATS 4329, any 3000-4000-level SPAN courses, and (LANG 4348 or LIT 3319 or LIT 3337 with a Latin American related subtitle).

courses.title: Free Elective
courses.choice_note: [7] Free Elective - any lower or upper-level course. Students may need to take some as upper-level to meet the university requirement of earning a minimum of 51 semester credit hours of upper-level courses.
